views.name: crm_visible_activities
views.definition:
SELECT a.id,
    a.organization_id,
    a.activity_type,
    a.subject,
    a.body,
    a.lead_id,
    a.contact_id,
    a.company_id,
    a.deal_id,
    a.member_id,
    a.due_at,
    a.completed_at,
    a.created_at,
    a.updated_at,
    a.remind_at,
    a.reminder_sent_at,
    COALESCE(a.company_id, c.company_id, d.company_id) AS account_company_id
   FROM crm_activities a
     LEFT JOIN contacts c ON c.id = a.contact_id AND c.organization_id = a.organization_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
     LEFT JOIN deals d ON d.id = a.deal_id AND d.organization_id = a.organization_id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
  WHERE can_access_module(a.organization_id, 'crm'::text) AND (a.deal_id IS NULL OR d.id IS NOT NULL AND crm_record_visible(d.organization_id, d.owner_id)) AND (a.lead_id IS NULL OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM leads l
          WHERE l.id = a.lead_id AND l.organization_id = a.organization_id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL AND crm_record_visible(l.organization_id, l.owner_id))));

views.name: v_pipeline_summary
views.definition:
SELECT organization_id,
    stage,
    count(*) AS deal_count,
    COALESCE(sum(value), 0::numeric) AS total_value,
    COALESCE(sum(value * probability::numeric / 100.0), 0::numeric) AS weighted_value,
    COALESCE(avg(probability), 0::numeric) AS avg_probability
   FROM deals d
  WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
  GROUP BY organization_id, stage;

views.name: v_sales_performance
views.definition:
SELECT d.organization_id,
    d.owner_id,
    p.full_name AS owner_name,
    count(*) AS total_deals,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.stage = 'closed_won'::deal_stage) AS won_deals,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.stage = 'closed_lost'::deal_stage) AS lost_deals,
    COALESCE(sum(d.value) FILTER (WHERE d.stage = 'closed_won'::deal_stage), 0::numeric) AS won_value,
    COALESCE(sum(d.value) FILTER (WHERE d.stage <> ALL (ARRAY['closed_won'::deal_stage, 'closed_lost'::deal_stage])), 0::numeric) AS open_value,
        CASE
            WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.stage = ANY (ARRAY['closed_won'::deal_stage, 'closed_lost'::deal_stage])) = 0 THEN 0::numeric
            ELSE round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.stage = 'closed_won'::deal_stage)::numeric / count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.stage = ANY (ARRAY['closed_won'::deal_stage, 'closed_lost'::deal_stage]))::numeric, 1)
        END AS win_rate
   FROM deals d
     LEFT JOIN organization_members om ON om.id = d.owner_id
     LEFT JOIN profiles p ON p.id = om.user_id
  WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL
  GROUP BY d.organization_id, d.owner_id, p.full_name;

views.name: v_crm_pipeline_owner
views.definition:
SELECT organization_id,
    owner_id,
    stage,
    count(*) AS deal_count,
    COALESCE(sum(value), 0::numeric) AS total_value,
    COALESCE(sum(value * probability::numeric / 100.0), 0::numeric) AS weighted_value
   FROM deals d
  WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
  GROUP BY organization_id, owner_id, stage;

views.name: v_dashboard_stats
views.definition:
SELECT id AS organization_id,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM organization_members om
          WHERE om.organization_id = o.id AND om.is_active) AS headcount,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM departments d
          WHERE d.organization_id = o.id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL) AS department_count,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM profiles p
             JOIN organization_members om2 ON om2.user_id = p.id
          WHERE om2.organization_id = o.id AND p.last_seen_at > (now() - '00:15:00'::interval)) AS online_now,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM projects pr
          WHERE pr.organization_id = o.id AND pr.status = 'active'::project_status AND pr.deleted_at IS NULL) AS active_projects,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM tasks t
          WHERE t.organization_id = o.id AND t.status <> 'done'::task_status AND t.deleted_at IS NULL) AS open_tasks,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM tasks t
          WHERE t.organization_id = o.id AND t.status <> 'done'::task_status AND t.due_date < CURRENT_DATE AND t.deleted_at IS NULL) AS overdue_tasks,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM support_tickets st
          WHERE st.organization_id = o.id AND (st.status <> ALL (ARRAY['resolved'::ticket_status, 'closed'::ticket_status])) AND st.deleted_at IS NULL) AS open_tickets,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM support_tickets st
          WHERE st.organization_id = o.id AND st.resolved_at IS NULL AND st.due_at < now() AND st.deleted_at IS NULL) AS breached_tickets,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(d.value * d.probability::numeric / 100.0), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
           FROM deals d
          WHERE d.organization_id = o.id AND (d.stage <> ALL (ARRAY['closed_won'::deal_stage, 'closed_lost'::deal_stage])) AND d.deleted_at IS NULL) AS weighted_pipeline,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(d.value), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
           FROM deals d
          WHERE d.organization_id = o.id AND (d.stage <> ALL (ARRAY['closed_won'::deal_stage, 'closed_lost'::deal_stage])) AND d.deleted_at IS NULL) AS open_pipeline,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(i.total), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
           FROM invoices i
          WHERE i.organization_id = o.id AND i.status = 'paid'::invoice_status AND i.deleted_at IS NULL) AS revenue_collected,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(i.total - i.amount_paid), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
           FROM invoices i
          WHERE i.organization_id = o.id AND (i.status <> ALL (ARRAY['paid'::invoice_status, 'cancelled'::invoice_status, 'draft'::invoice_status])) AND i.deleted_at IS NULL) AS receivables,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM leave_requests lr
          WHERE lr.organization_id = o.id AND lr.status = 'pending'::leave_status) AS pending_leave,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM expenses e
          WHERE e.organization_id = o.id AND e.status = 'pending'::expense_status AND e.deleted_at IS NULL) AS pending_expenses,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM products pr
          WHERE pr.organization_id = o.id AND pr.is_active AND pr.deleted_at IS NULL AND pr.stock <= pr.reorder_level) AS low_stock_products
   FROM organizations o
  WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;

functions.name: crm_directory_summary
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crm_directory_summary(p_org uuid, p_kind text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE WHEN p_kind='company' THEN jsonb_build_object(
 'total',(SELECT count(*) FROM companies WHERE organization_id=p_org AND deleted_at IS NULL),
 'new_records',(SELECT count(*) FROM companies WHERE organization_id=p_org AND deleted_at IS NULL AND created_at>=now()-interval '30 days'),
 'unassigned',(SELECT count(*) FROM companies WHERE organization_id=p_org AND deleted_at IS NULL AND owner_id IS NULL),
 'with_opportunities',(SELECT count(DISTINCT company_id) FROM deals WHERE organization_id=p_org AND deleted_at IS NULL AND stage NOT IN('closed_won','closed_lost') AND public.crm_record_visible(organization_id,owner_id) AND company_id IN(SELECT id FROM companies WHERE organization_id=p_org AND deleted_at IS NULL))
 ) ELSE jsonb_build_object(
 'total',(SELECT count(*) FROM contacts WHERE organization_id=p_org AND deleted_at IS NULL),
 'active',(SELECT count(*) FROM contacts WHERE organization_id=p_org AND deleted_at IS NULL AND is_active),
 'unassigned',(SELECT count(*) FROM contacts WHERE organization_id=p_org AND deleted_at IS NULL AND owner_id IS NULL),
 'decision_makers',(SELECT count(*) FROM contacts WHERE organization_id=p_org AND deleted_at IS NULL AND is_active AND lower(crm_profile->>'relationshipRole') IN('decision-maker','economic buyer'))
 ) END WHERE public.can_access_module(p_org,'crm');
$function$

functions.name: crm_convert_lead
crm_customer_brief
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crm_customer_brief(p_org uuid, p_company uuid, p_today date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
WITH valid AS (SELECT id FROM companies WHERE organization_id=p_org AND id=p_company AND deleted_at IS NULL AND public.can_access_module(p_org,'crm')),
engagement AS (
 SELECT a.* FROM crm_activities a WHERE a.organization_id=p_org AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM valid)
 AND (a.company_id=p_company OR a.contact_id IN(SELECT id FROM contacts WHERE organization_id=p_org AND company_id=p_company AND deleted_at IS NULL)
 OR a.deal_id IN(SELECT id FROM deals WHERE organization_id=p_org AND company_id=p_company AND deleted_at IS NULL AND public.crm_record_visible(organization_id,owner_id)))
 AND (a.deal_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM deals d WHERE d.id=a.deal_id AND d.organization_id=p_org AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND public.crm_record_visible(d.organization_id,d.owner_id)))
 AND (a.lead_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM leads l WHERE l.id=a.lead_id AND l.organization_id=p_org AND l.deleted_at IS NULL AND public.crm_record_visible(l.organization_id,l.owner_id)))
), paid AS (
 SELECT i.currency,sum(p.amount) AS collected FROM payments p JOIN invoices i ON i.id=p.invoice_id AND i.organization_id=p.organization_id
 WHERE p.organization_id=p_org AND i.company_id IN(SELECT id FROM valid) AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND public.can_access_module(p_org,'finance') GROUP BY i.currency
)
SELECT public.crm_account_summary(p_org,p_company,p_today) || jsonb_build_object(
 'invoice_balances',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('currency',currency,'outstanding',outstanding,'overdue',overdue) ORDER BY currency) FROM (
 SELECT currency,sum(greatest(total-amount_paid,0)) outstanding,count(*) FILTER(WHERE due_date<p_today) overdue
 FROM invoices WHERE organization_id=p_org AND company_id IN(SELECT id FROM valid) AND deleted_at IS NULL
 AND status IN('sent','partially_paid','overdue') AND total>amount_paid AND public.can_access_module(p_org,'finance') GROUP BY currency
 ) balances),'[]'::jsonb),
 'active_projects',(SELECT count(*) FROM crm_visible_projects WHERE organization_id=p_org AND client_company_id IN(SELECT id FROM valid) AND status IN('active','planning')),
 'projects_at_risk',(SELECT count(*) FROM v_project_health h JOIN crm_visible_projects p ON p.id=h.project_id AND p.organization_id=h.organization_id WHERE p.organization_id=p_org AND p.client_company_id IN(SELECT id FROM valid) AND h.is_at_risk),
 'last_contact',(SELECT max(coalesce(completed_at,created_at)) FROM engagement WHERE activity_type IN('call','email','meeting') AND (due_at IS NULL OR completed_at IS NOT NULL)),
 'next_follow_up',(SELECT min(due_at) FROM engagement WHERE due_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NULL),
 'overdue_actions',(SELECT count(*) FROM engagement WHERE due_at::date<p_today AND completed_at IS NULL) +
 (SELECT count(*) FROM crm_account_plans p CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(p.items) i WHERE p.organization_id=p_org AND p.company_id IN(SELECT id FROM valid) AND i->>'kind'='action' AND i->>'status'<>'completed' AND nullif(i->>'dueDate','')::date<p_today),
 'decision_makers',(SELECT count(*) FROM contacts WHERE organization_id=p_org AND company_id IN(SELECT id FROM valid) AND deleted_at IS NULL AND is_active AND lower(crm_profile->>'relationshipRole') IN('decision-maker','economic buyer')),
 'stalled_deals',(SELECT count(*) FROM deals WHERE organization_id=p_org AND company_id IN(SELECT id FROM valid) AND deleted_at IS NULL AND stage NOT IN('closed_won','closed_lost') AND updated_at<now()-interval '30 days' AND public.crm_record_visible(organization_id,owner_id)),
 'collected_payments',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('currency',currency,'collected',collected) ORDER BY currency) FROM paid),'[]'::jsonb)
);
$function$

functions.name: crm_pipeline_workspace
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crm_pipeline_workspace(p_org uuid, p_pipeline uuid, p_filters jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 WITH visible AS (
  SELECT d.*,s.inactivity_days,
    CASE WHEN d.stage='closed_won' THEN 'won' WHEN d.stage='closed_lost' THEN 'lost' ELSE d.forecast_category END bucket
  FROM deals d LEFT JOIN crm_pipeline_stages s ON s.id=d.pipeline_stage_id AND s.organization_id=d.organization_id
  WHERE d.organization_id=p_org AND d.pipeline_id=p_pipeline AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND public.crm_record_visible(d.organization_id,d.owner_id)
    AND (coalesce(p_filters->>'forecastCategory','')='' OR d.forecast_category=p_filters->>'forecastCategory')
    AND (coalesce(p_filters->>'stage','')='' OR (p_filters->>'stage'='open' AND d.stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost')) OR d.stage::text=p_filters->>'stage')
    AND (coalesce(p_filters->>'search','')='' OR position(lower(p_filters->>'search') in lower(d.name))>0 OR position(lower(p_filters->>'search') in lower(coalesce(d.notes,'')))>0)
    AND (nullif(p_filters->>'ownerId','') IS NULL OR d.owner_id=(p_filters->>'ownerId')::uuid)
    AND (nullif(p_filters->>'teamMemberId','') IS NULL OR (p_filters->>'teamMemberId')::uuid=ANY(d.deal_team_ids))
    AND (nullif(p_filters->>'companyId','') IS NULL OR d.company_id=(p_filters->>'companyId')::uuid)
    AND (nullif(p_filters->>'pipelineStageId','') IS NULL OR d.pipeline_stage_id=(p_filters->>'pipelineStageId')::uuid)
    AND (nullif(p_filters->>'closeFrom','') IS NULL OR d.expected_close>=(p_filters->>'closeFrom')::date)
    AND (nullif(p_filters->>'closeTo','') IS NULL OR d.expected_close<=(p_filters->>'closeTo')::date)
    AND (nullif(p_filters->>'minValue','') IS NULL OR d.value>=(p_filters->>'minValue')::numeric)
    AND (nullif(p_filters->>'maxValue','') IS NULL OR d.value<=(p_filters->>'maxValue')::numeric)
 ), facts AS (
  SELECT v.*,
   (SELECT max(coalesce(a.completed_at,a.created_at)) FROM crm_activities a WHERE a.organization_id=p_org AND a.deal_id=v.id AND a.activity_type IN ('call','email','meeting','video','visit','demo') AND (a.due_at IS NULL OR a.completed_at IS NOT NULL)) last_activity,
   (SELECT max(e.created_at) FROM crm_pipeline_events e WHERE e.organization_id=p_org AND e.deal_id=v.id AND e.to_stage_id=v.pipeline_stage_id AND e.from_stage_id IS DISTINCT FROM e.to_stage_id) stage_since,
   EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_activities a WHERE a.organization_id=p_org AND a.deal_id=v.id AND a.due_at<now() AND a.completed_at IS NULL) overdue_followup,
   EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_stage_approvals a JOIN crm_pipelines p ON p.id=v.pipeline_id WHERE a.organization_id=p_org AND a.deal_id=v.id AND a.status='pending' AND a.deal_version=v.pipeline_version AND a.pipeline_version=p.version) awaiting_approval
  FROM visible v WHERE v.stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost')
 ), risks AS (
  SELECT id,name,value,expected_close,next_step,last_activity,stage_since,
   array_remove(ARRAY[
    CASE WHEN expected_close<coalesce(nullif(p_filters->>'today','')::date,current_date) THEN 'Past expected close' END,
    CASE WHEN btrim(next_step)='' THEN 'Missing next step' END,
    CASE WHEN overdue_followup THEN 'Overdue follow-up' END,
    CASE WHEN awaiting_approval THEN 'Awaiting approval' END,
    CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_opportunity_plans p CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(p.stakeholders) s WHERE p.organization_id=p_org AND p.deal_id=facts.id AND s->>'role' IN ('decision_maker','economic_buyer')) THEN 'No documented opportunity decision-maker' END,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_pipeline_stages s CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(s.required_fields) field JOIN deals d ON d.id=facts.id WHERE s.id=facts.pipeline_stage_id AND s.organization_id=p_org AND (crm_visible_deal_requirement(p_org,d.id,field) IS NULL OR crm_visible_deal_requirement(p_org,d.id,field)='null'::jsonb OR btrim(crm_visible_deal_requirement(p_org,d.id,field)#>>'{}')='' OR (field='value' AND d.value<=0))) THEN 'Incomplete current-stage evidence' END,
    CASE WHEN coalesce(last_activity,created_at)<now()-make_interval(days=>coalesce(inactivity_days,30)) THEN 'No recent recorded engagement' END,
    CASE WHEN stage_since<now()-make_interval(days=>coalesce(inactivity_days,30)) THEN 'Long stage duration' END
   ],NULL) signals,inactivity_days
  FROM facts
 ), stages AS (
  SELECT pipeline_stage_id stage_id,count(*) deal_count,sum(value) total_value,sum(CASE WHEN stage IN ('closed_won','closed_lost') THEN 0 ELSE value*probability/100 END) weighted_value
  FROM visible GROUP BY pipeline_stage_id
 ), forecast AS (
  SELECT bucket category,count(*) deal_count,sum(value) total_value,sum(CASE WHEN bucket IN ('won','lost','omitted') THEN 0 ELSE value*probability/100 END) weighted_value
  FROM visible GROUP BY bucket
 ) SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'stages',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(stages)) FROM stages),'[]'::jsonb),
  'forecast',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(forecast)) FROM forecast),'[]'::jsonb),
  'risks',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)) FROM (SELECT * FROM risks WHERE cardinality(signals)>0 ORDER BY cardinality(signals) DESC,id LIMIT 50) r),'[]'::jsonb),
  'riskCount',(SELECT count(*) FROM risks WHERE cardinality(signals)>0),
  'periods',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(m)) FROM (SELECT coalesce(to_char(expected_close,'YYYY-MM'),'Unscheduled') period,count(*) deal_count,sum(value) total_value,sum(value*probability/100) weighted_value FROM visible WHERE stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost') AND forecast_category<>'omitted' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1) m),'[]'::jsonb),
  'owners',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(o)) FROM (SELECT owner_id,count(*) deal_count,sum(value) total_value,sum(value*probability/100) weighted_value FROM visible WHERE stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost') AND forecast_category<>'omitted' GROUP BY owner_id ORDER BY sum(value) DESC) o),'[]'::jsonb),
  'lossReasons',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(l)) FROM (SELECT coalesce(nullif(btrim(lost_reason),''),'Not recorded') reason,count(*) deal_count FROM visible WHERE stage='closed_lost' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 20) l),'[]'::jsonb),
  'averageWonCycleDays',(SELECT round(avg(extract(epoch FROM (closed_at-created_at))/86400),1) FROM visible WHERE stage='closed_won' AND closed_at>=created_at),
  'stageConversion',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c)) FROM (
   SELECT source.id stage_id,count(DISTINCT e.deal_id) departed_deals,count(DISTINCT e.deal_id) FILTER(WHERE target.position>source.position AND target.canonical_stage<>'closed_lost') advanced_deals
   FROM crm_pipeline_events e JOIN visible v ON v.id=e.deal_id JOIN crm_pipeline_stages source ON source.id=e.from_stage_id JOIN crm_pipeline_stages target ON target.id=e.to_stage_id
   WHERE e.organization_id=p_org AND e.from_stage_id IS DISTINCT FROM e.to_stage_id AND source.canonical_stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost')
   GROUP BY source.id
  ) c),'[]'::jsonb),
  'stageAging',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a)) FROM (SELECT pipeline_stage_id stage_id,count(*) deal_count,count(stage_since) known_entry_count,round(avg(extract(epoch FROM (now()-stage_since))/86400),1) average_days FROM facts GROUP BY pipeline_stage_id) a),'[]'::jsonb),
  'metrics',(SELECT jsonb_build_object(
   'openCount',count(*) FILTER(WHERE stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost')),
   'openValue',coalesce(sum(value) FILTER(WHERE stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost')),0),
   'weightedValue',coalesce(sum(value*probability/100) FILTER(WHERE stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost')),0),
   'closingSoon',count(*) FILTER(WHERE stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost') AND expected_close BETWEEN coalesce(nullif(p_filters->>'today','')::date,current_date) AND coalesce(nullif(p_filters->>'today','')::date,current_date)+14),
   'pastClose',count(*) FILTER(WHERE stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost') AND expected_close<coalesce(nullif(p_filters->>'today','')::date,current_date)),
   'missingNextStep',count(*) FILTER(WHERE stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost') AND btrim(next_step)=''),
   'averageAge',coalesce(round(avg(extract(epoch FROM (now()-created_at))/86400) FILTER(WHERE stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost'))),0),
   'wonCount',count(*) FILTER(WHERE stage='closed_won'),
   'lostCount',count(*) FILTER(WHERE stage='closed_lost'),
   'wonValue',coalesce(sum(value) FILTER(WHERE stage='closed_won'),0)
  ) FROM visible)
 )
$function$

functions.name: member_deletion_impact
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.member_deletion_impact(target_member uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  target     organization_members;
  prof       profiles;
  org        uuid;
  rec        record;
  n          bigint;
  items      jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  blockers   jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  needs      boolean := false;
  owners_left int;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO target FROM organization_members WHERE id = target_member;
  IF target.id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'That member does not exist.' USING ERRCODE = 'no_data_found';
  END IF;
  org := target.organization_id;

  IF NOT public.is_org_admin(org) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only owners and administrators may review an account for deletion.'
      USING ERRCODE = 'insufficient_privilege';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO prof FROM profiles WHERE id = target.user_id;

  -- ── Blockers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  IF target.user_id = auth.uid() THEN
    blockers := blockers || to_jsonb('You cannot delete your own account. Ask another administrator.'::text);
  END IF;
  IF target.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN
    blockers := blockers || to_jsonb('This account has already been deleted.'::text);
  END IF;
  IF target.role = 'owner' THEN
    SELECT count(*) INTO owners_left FROM organization_members
     WHERE organization_id = org AND role = 'owner' AND is_active
       AND deleted_at IS NULL AND id <> target_member;
    IF owners_left = 0 THEN
      blockers := blockers ||
        to_jsonb('This is the only owner. Promote another member to owner first.'::text);
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- ── What points at them ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  --
  -- Driven from a table rather than written out, and every entry is checked
  -- against the catalogue first, so a column renamed in a later migration
  -- makes this report one line shorter instead of raising 42703 in the middle
  -- of a deletion review.
  FOR rec IN
    SELECT * FROM (VALUES
      -- Live responsibility. Reassigned on deletion.
      ('departments',           'head_id',     'Departments they head',        'reassign'),
      ('teams',                 'lead_id',     'Teams they lead',              'reassign'),
      ('organization_members',  'manager_id',  'People reporting to them',     'reassign'),
      ('projects',              'owner_id',    'Projects they own',            'reassign'),
      ('milestones',            'owner_id',    'Milestones they own',          'reassign'),
      ('tasks',                 'assignee_id', 'Tasks assigned to them',       'reassign'),
      ('leads',                 'owner_id',    'Leads they own',               'reassign'),
      ('deals',                 'owner_id',    'Deals they own',               'reassign'),
      ('companies',             'owner_id',    'Customers they own',           'reassign'),
      ('contacts',              'owner_id',    'Contacts they own',            'reassign'),
      ('invoices',              'owner_id',    'Invoices they own',            'reassign'),
      ('support_tickets',       'assignee_id', 'Tickets assigned to them',     'reassign'),
      -- The past. Left pointing at the tombstone.
      ('messages',              'sender_id',   'Messages they sent',           'retain'),
      ('comments',              'author_id',   'Comments they wrote',          'retain'),
      ('ticket_comments',       'author_id',   'Ticket replies they wrote',    'retain'),
      ('announcements',         'author_id',   'Announcements they published', 'retain'),
      ('kb_articles',           'author_id',   'Knowledge articles they wrote','retain'),
      ('meetings',              'host_id',     'Meetings they hosted',         'retain'),
      ('expenses',              'approved_by', 'Expenses they approved',       'retain'),
      ('leave_requests',        'approved_by', 'Leave they approved',          'retain'),
      ('purchase_orders',       'approved_by', 'Purchase orders they approved','retain'),
      ('payments',              'recorded_by', 'Payments they recorded',       'retain'),
      ('stock_movements',       'member_id',   'Stock movements they made',    'retain'),
      ('workspace_pages',       'created_by',  'Workspace pages they created', 'retain'),
      ('files',                 'uploaded_by', 'Files they uploaded',          'retain'),
      ('activity_log',          'member_id',   'Activity log entries',         'retain'),
      -- Theirs. Retained; employment records outlive employment.
      ('attendance_records',    'member_id',   'Attendance records',           'personal'),
      ('leave_requests',        'member_id',   'Leave requests',               'personal'),
      ('leave_balances',        'member_id',   'Leave balances',               'personal'),
      ('time_entries',          'member_id',   'Time entries',                 'personal'),
      ('todos',                 'member_id',   'Private to-dos',               'personal'),
      -- Rosters and access. Removed on deletion.
      ('project_members',       'member_id',   'Project memberships',          'revoke'),
      ('team_members',          'member_id',   'Team memberships',             'revoke'),
      ('channel_members',       'member_id',   'Channel memberships',          'revoke'),
      ('event_attendees',       'member_id',   'Calendar invitations',         'revoke'),
      ('meeting_participants',  'member_id',   'Meeting invitations',          'revoke'),
      ('workspace_page_shares', 'member_id',   'Page shares',                  'revoke'),
      ('notifications',         'recipient_id','Undelivered notifications',    'revoke')
    ) AS t(tbl, col, label, kind)
  LOOP
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
      WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = rec.tbl AND column_name = rec.col
    ) THEN
      CONTINUE;
    END IF;

    EXECUTE format('SELECT count(*) FROM public.%I WHERE %I = $1', rec.tbl, rec.col)
      INTO n USING target_member;

    IF n > 0 THEN
      items := items || jsonb_build_object(
        'table', rec.tbl, 'column', rec.col,
        'label', rec.label, 'kind', rec.kind, 'count', n
      );
      IF rec.kind = 'reassign' THEN needs := true; END IF;
    END IF;
  END LOOP;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'memberId',            target_member,
    'userId',              target.user_id,
    'email',               prof.email,
    'fullName',            prof.full_name,
    'role',                target.role,
    'status',              target.status,
    'alreadyDeleted',      target.deleted_at IS NOT NULL,
    'blockers',            blockers,
    'canDelete',           jsonb_array_length(blockers) = 0,
    'requiresReassignment', needs,
    'items',               items,
    /**
     * Whether the auth identity itself goes.
     *
     * Only when this is their last live membership. Someone who also works for
     * another tenant on this platform loses access *here* and keeps their
     * account — deleting the login because one of their employers ended the
     * relationship would be a cross-tenant action, which is exactly the class
     * of mistake tenancy exists to prevent.
     */
    'removesPlatformIdentity', (
      SELECT count(*) = 1 FROM organization_members
      WHERE user_id = target.user_id AND deleted_at IS NULL
    ),
    'otherOrganizations', (
      SELECT count(*) FROM organization_members
      WHERE user_id = target.user_id AND deleted_at IS NULL AND id <> target_member
    )
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crm_account_summary(p_org uuid, p_company uuid, p_today date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  WITH customer AS (
    SELECT id FROM companies WHERE id = p_company AND organization_id = p_org AND deleted_at IS NULL
      AND public.can_access_module(p_org, 'crm')
  ), deal_totals AS (
    SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost')) AS open_count,
      coalesce(sum(value) FILTER (WHERE stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost')),0) AS open_value,
      coalesce(sum(value) FILTER (WHERE stage = 'closed_won'),0) AS won_value
    FROM deals WHERE organization_id = p_org AND company_id IN (SELECT id FROM customer) AND deleted_at IS NULL
      AND public.crm_record_visible(organization_id,owner_id)
  ), invoice_totals AS (
    SELECT currency, coalesce(sum(greatest(total - amount_paid,0)),0) AS outstanding,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE due_date < p_today) AS overdue
    FROM invoices WHERE organization_id = p_org AND company_id IN (SELECT id FROM customer) AND deleted_at IS NULL
      AND status NOT IN ('paid','cancelled') AND public.can_access_module(p_org,'finance')
    GROUP BY currency
  ), project_totals AS (
    SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.status IN ('active','planning')) AS active,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE h.is_at_risk) AS at_risk
    FROM projects p LEFT JOIN v_project_health h ON h.project_id=p.id AND h.organization_id=p.organization_id
    WHERE p.organization_id=p_org AND p.client_company_id IN (SELECT id FROM customer) AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND public.can_access_module(p_org,'projects')
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'contacts', (SELECT count(*) FROM contacts WHERE organization_id=p_org AND company_id IN (SELECT id FROM customer) AND deleted_at IS NULL),
    'open_deals', d.open_count, 'open_deal_value', d.open_value, 'won_deal_value', d.won_value,
    'active_projects', p.active, 'projects_at_risk', p.at_risk,
    'last_contact', (SELECT max(coalesce(completed_at,created_at)) FROM crm_activities WHERE organization_id=p_org AND company_id IN (SELECT id FROM customer) AND (due_at IS NULL OR completed_at IS NOT NULL)),
    'next_follow_up', (SELECT min(due_at) FROM crm_activities WHERE organization_id=p_org AND company_id IN (SELECT id FROM customer) AND completed_at IS NULL),
    'invoice_balances', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('currency',currency,'outstanding',outstanding,'overdue',overdue) ORDER BY currency) FROM invoice_totals),'[]'),
    'open_tickets', (SELECT count(*) FROM support_tickets t JOIN contacts c ON c.id=t.contact_id AND c.organization_id=t.organization_id
      WHERE t.organization_id=p_org AND c.company_id IN (SELECT id FROM customer) AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND t.status NOT IN ('resolved','closed') AND public.can_access_module(p_org,'support'))
  ) FROM deal_totals d CROSS JOIN project_totals p;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crm_pipeline_summary(p_org uuid, p_pipeline uuid, p_search text DEFAULT ''::text, p_owner uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date)
 RETURNS TABLE(stage_id uuid, deal_count bigint, total_value numeric, weighted_value numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT d.pipeline_stage_id,count(*),coalesce(sum(d.value),0),coalesce(sum(d.value*d.probability/100),0)
 FROM deals d WHERE d.organization_id=p_org AND d.pipeline_id=p_pipeline AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
 AND public.crm_record_visible(d.organization_id,d.owner_id)
 AND (coalesce(p_search,'')='' OR position(lower(p_search) in lower(d.name))>0 OR position(lower(p_search) in lower(coalesce(d.notes,'')))>0)
 AND (p_owner IS NULL OR d.owner_id=p_owner) AND (p_from IS NULL OR d.expected_close>=p_from) AND (p_to IS NULL OR d.expected_close<=p_to)
 GROUP BY d.pipeline_stage_id
$function$

functions.name: crm_sales_insights
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crm_sales_insights(p_org uuid, p_from date, p_to date, p_zone text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF p_from IS NULL OR p_to IS NULL OR p_to<p_from OR p_to-p_from>730 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_timezone_names WHERE name=p_zone) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid reporting period or timezone' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 RETURN (
 WITH bounds AS(SELECT p_from::timestamp AT TIME ZONE p_zone AS start_at,(p_to+1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE p_zone AS end_at,(p_from-(p_to-p_from+1))::timestamp AT TIME ZONE p_zone AS previous_at),
 visible_leads AS(SELECT l.* FROM leads l WHERE l.organization_id=p_org AND l.deleted_at IS NULL AND public.crm_record_visible(l.organization_id,l.owner_id)),
 visible_deals AS(SELECT d.* FROM deals d WHERE d.organization_id=p_org AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND public.crm_record_visible(d.organization_id,d.owner_id)),
 responses AS(SELECT l.id,l.created_at,l.owner_id,min(coalesce(a.completed_at,a.created_at)) FILTER(WHERE a.activity_type IN ('call','email','meeting') AND (a.due_at IS NULL OR a.completed_at IS NOT NULL) AND coalesce(a.completed_at,a.created_at)>=l.created_at) AS first_at,max(coalesce(a.completed_at,a.created_at)) FILTER(WHERE a.activity_type IN ('call','email','meeting') AND (a.due_at IS NULL OR a.completed_at IS NOT NULL)) AS last_at FROM visible_leads l LEFT JOIN crm_activities a ON a.lead_id=l.id AND a.organization_id=p_org GROUP BY l.id,l.created_at,l.owner_id),
 cohort AS(SELECT l.* FROM visible_leads l,bounds b WHERE l.created_at>=b.start_at AND l.created_at<b.end_at),
 months AS(SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('month',p_from::timestamp),date_trunc('month',p_to::timestamp),interval '1 month') AS month),
 priorities AS(SELECT d.id,d.name,d.expected_close,d.next_step,d.contact_id,d.pipeline_version,
 NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM contacts c WHERE c.id=d.contact_id AND c.organization_id=p_org AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND (nullif(btrim(c.crm_profile->>'influence'),'') IS NOT NULL OR nullif(btrim(c.crm_profile->>'relationshipRole'),'') IS NOT NULL)) AS missing_decision_context,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM visible_leads l JOIN crm_qualification_frameworks f ON f.organization_id=l.organization_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(f.fields) field WHERE l.converted_deal_id=d.id AND (field->>'required')::boolean AND (l.qualification->(field->>'key') IS NULL OR l.qualification->(field->>'key')='null'::jsonb OR btrim(l.qualification->>(field->>'key'))='')) AS incomplete_qualification,
 coalesce((SELECT max(e.created_at) FROM crm_pipeline_events e WHERE e.deal_id=d.id AND e.organization_id=p_org AND e.to_stage_id=d.pipeline_stage_id AND e.from_stage_id IS DISTINCT FROM e.to_stage_id),(SELECT max(e.created_at) FROM deal_stage_events e WHERE e.deal_id=d.id AND e.organization_id=p_org AND e.to_stage=d.stage),d.created_at) AS stage_since,
 coalesce(s.inactivity_days,30) AS threshold,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM crm_pipeline_events e WHERE e.deal_id=d.id AND e.organization_id=p_org AND e.next_close>e.previous_close) AS postponements,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_stage_approvals a JOIN crm_pipelines p ON p.id=d.pipeline_id WHERE a.deal_id=d.id AND a.organization_id=p_org AND a.status='pending' AND a.deal_version=d.pipeline_version AND a.pipeline_version=p.version) AS pending_approval
 FROM visible_deals d LEFT JOIN crm_pipeline_stages s ON s.id=d.pipeline_stage_id WHERE d.stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost'))
 SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'period',jsonb_build_object('from',p_from,'to',p_to),
 'leads',jsonb_build_object('current',(SELECT count(*) FROM cohort),'previous',(SELECT count(*) FROM visible_leads l,bounds b WHERE l.created_at>=b.previous_at AND l.created_at<b.start_at),'converted',(SELECT count(*) FROM cohort WHERE converted_at IS NOT NULL),'qualifiedNow',(SELECT count(*) FROM cohort WHERE status='qualified'),'previousQualifiedNow',(SELECT count(*) FROM visible_leads l,bounds b WHERE l.created_at>=b.previous_at AND l.created_at<b.start_at AND l.status='qualified'),'unassigned',(SELECT count(*) FROM visible_leads WHERE owner_id IS NULL)),
 'cohort',jsonb_build_object('created',(SELECT count(*) FROM cohort),'converted',(SELECT count(*) FROM cohort WHERE converted_at IS NOT NULL),'opportunities',(SELECT count(*) FROM cohort l JOIN visible_deals d ON d.id=l.converted_deal_id),'won',(SELECT count(*) FROM cohort l JOIN visible_deals d ON d.id=l.converted_deal_id WHERE d.stage='closed_won')),
 'responses',jsonb_build_object('medianHours',(SELECT percentile_cont(.5) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM(first_at-created_at))/3600) FROM responses WHERE first_at IS NOT NULL),'sampleCount',(SELECT count(*) FROM responses WHERE first_at IS NOT NULL),'unansweredAfter24Hours',(SELECT count(*) FROM responses WHERE first_at IS NULL AND created_at<now()-interval '24 hours'),'quietAfter14Days',(SELECT count(*) FROM responses WHERE last_at<now()-interval '14 days')),
 'sources',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(x) FROM(SELECT coalesce(nullif(btrim(source),''),'Unknown') AS source,count(*) AS leads,count(*) FILTER(WHERE converted_at IS NOT NULL) AS converted FROM cohort GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC)x),'[]'::jsonb),
 'acquisition',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(x ORDER BY x.period) FROM(SELECT to_char(m.month,'YYYY-MM') AS period,(SELECT count(*) FROM companies c WHERE c.organization_id=p_org AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.created_at AT TIME ZONE p_zone>=greatest(m.month,p_from::timestamp) AND c.created_at AT TIME ZONE p_zone<least(m.month+interval '1 month',(p_to+1)::timestamp)) AS accounts,(SELECT count(*) FROM visible_leads l WHERE l.converted_at AT TIME ZONE p_zone>=greatest(m.month,p_from::timestamp) AND l.converted_at AT TIME ZONE p_zone<least(m.month+interval '1 month',(p_to+1)::timestamp)) AS converted FROM months m)x),'[]'::jsonb),
 'activities',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(x) FROM(SELECT a.activity_type,count(*) AS logged,count(*) FILTER(WHERE a.completed_at IS NOT NULL) AS completed FROM crm_activities a,bounds b WHERE a.organization_id=p_org AND a.created_at>=b.start_at AND a.created_at<b.end_at AND (public.auth_role_in(p_org)<>'sales_staff' OR a.member_id=public.auth_member_id(p_org)) GROUP BY a.activity_type)x),'[]'::jsonb),
 'priorityCount',(SELECT count(*) FROM priorities WHERE btrim(next_step)='' OR contact_id IS NULL OR missing_decision_context OR incomplete_qualification OR postponements>=2 OR pending_approval OR stage_since<now()-threshold*interval '1 day'),
 'priorities',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(x) FROM(SELECT id,name,expected_close,stage_since,threshold,postponements,pending_approval,btrim(next_step)='' AS missing_next_step,contact_id IS NULL AS missing_contact,missing_decision_context,incomplete_qualification FROM priorities WHERE btrim(next_step)='' OR contact_id IS NULL OR missing_decision_context OR incomplete_qualification OR postponements>=2 OR pending_approval OR stage_since<now()-threshold*interval '1 day' ORDER BY pending_approval DESC,stage_since,id LIMIT 30)x),'[]'::jsonb)
 ));
END
$function$

functions.name: crm_relationship_timeline
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crm_relationship_timeline(p_org uuid, p_company uuid, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0, p_limit integer DEFAULT 30)
 RETURNS TABLE(event_key text, module text, record_type text, record_id uuid, title text, occurred_at timestamp with time zone, detail text, total_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 WITH valid AS(SELECT id FROM companies WHERE id=p_company AND organization_id=p_org AND deleted_at IS NULL AND public.can_access_module(p_org,'crm')),
 people AS(SELECT id FROM contacts WHERE organization_id=p_org AND company_id=p_company AND deleted_at IS NULL),
 opportunities AS(SELECT * FROM deals WHERE organization_id=p_org AND company_id=p_company AND deleted_at IS NULL AND public.crm_record_visible(organization_id,owner_id)),
 prospects AS(SELECT * FROM leads WHERE organization_id=p_org AND converted_contact_id IN(SELECT id FROM people) AND deleted_at IS NULL AND public.crm_record_visible(organization_id,owner_id)),
 events AS(
 SELECT 'activity:'||a.id AS event_key,'crm'::text AS module,
 CASE WHEN a.deal_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'deal' WHEN a.lead_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'lead' WHEN a.contact_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'contact' ELSE 'company' END AS record_type,
 coalesce(a.deal_id,a.lead_id,a.contact_id,a.company_id) AS record_id,a.subject AS title,coalesce(a.completed_at,a.created_at) AS occurred_at,
 a.activity_type||CASE WHEN a.due_at IS NOT NULL AND a.completed_at IS NULL THEN ' · scheduled follow-up' ELSE ' · logged activity' END AS detail
 FROM crm_activities a WHERE a.organization_id=p_org AND (a.company_id=p_company OR a.contact_id IN(SELECT id FROM people) OR a.deal_id IN(SELECT id FROM opportunities) OR a.lead_id IN(SELECT id FROM prospects))
 AND (a.deal_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM deals d WHERE d.id=a.deal_id AND d.organization_id=p_org AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND public.crm_record_visible(d.organization_id,d.owner_id)))
 AND (a.lead_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM leads l WHERE l.id=a.lead_id AND l.organization_id=p_org AND l.deleted_at IS NULL AND public.crm_record_visible(l.organization_id,l.owner_id)))
 UNION ALL SELECT 'lead:'||id,'crm','lead',id,btrim(first_name||' '||last_name),converted_at,'Lead converted' FROM prospects WHERE converted_at IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT 'deal-created:'||id,'crm','deal',id,name,created_at,'Opportunity created' FROM opportunities
 UNION ALL SELECT 'deal-closed:'||id,'crm','deal',id,name,closed_at,CASE WHEN stage='closed_won' THEN 'Deal won' ELSE 'Deal lost' END FROM opportunities WHERE stage IN ('closed_won','closed_lost') AND closed_at IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT 'project:'||id,'projects','project',id,name,created_at,'Project created · current status: '||status::text FROM projects WHERE organization_id=p_org AND client_company_id=p_company AND deleted_at IS NULL AND public.can_access_module(p_org,'projects')
 UNION ALL SELECT 'invoice:'||id,'finance','invoice',id,invoice_number,created_at,'Invoice created · '||currency||' '||total::text FROM invoices WHERE organization_id=p_org AND company_id=p_company AND deleted_at IS NULL AND public.can_access_module(p_org,'finance')
 UNION ALL SELECT 'payment:'||p.id,'finance','invoice',i.id,i.invoice_number,p.paid_at,'Payment recorded · '||i.currency||' '||p.amount::text FROM payments p JOIN invoices i ON i.id=p.invoice_id AND i.organization_id=p.organization_id WHERE p.organization_id=p_org AND i.company_id=p_company AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND public.can_access_module(p_org,'finance')
 UNION ALL SELECT 'ticket:'||id,'support','ticket',id,subject,created_at,'Support ticket opened' FROM support_tickets WHERE organization_id=p_org AND contact_id IN(SELECT id FROM people) AND deleted_at IS NULL AND public.can_access_module(p_org,'support')
 UNION ALL SELECT 'ticket-resolved:'||id,'support','ticket',id,subject,resolved_at,'Support ticket resolved' FROM support_tickets WHERE organization_id=p_org AND contact_id IN(SELECT id FROM people) AND deleted_at IS NULL AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND public.can_access_module(p_org,'support')
 ) SELECT e.*,count(*) OVER() FROM events e WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM valid) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC,event_key DESC OFFSET greatest(0,least(p_offset,100000)) LIMIT greatest(1,least(p_limit,50))
$function$

functions.name: crm_pipeline_forecast
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crm_pipeline_forecast(p_org uuid, p_pipeline uuid, p_search text DEFAULT ''::text, p_owner uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date)
 RETURNS TABLE(category text, deal_count bigint, total_value numeric, weighted_value numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 WITH visible AS (
  SELECT d.*,CASE WHEN d.stage='closed_won' THEN 'won' WHEN d.stage='closed_lost' THEN 'lost' ELSE d.forecast_category END AS bucket
  FROM deals d WHERE d.organization_id=p_org AND d.pipeline_id=p_pipeline AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
   AND public.crm_record_visible(d.organization_id,d.owner_id)
   AND (coalesce(p_search,'')='' OR position(lower(p_search) in lower(d.name))>0 OR position(lower(p_search) in lower(coalesce(d.notes,'')))>0)
   AND (p_owner IS NULL OR d.owner_id=p_owner)
   AND (p_from IS NULL OR d.expected_close>=p_from) AND (p_to IS NULL OR d.expected_close<=p_to)
 ) SELECT bucket,count(*),coalesce(sum(value),0),
   coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN bucket IN ('won','lost','omitted') THEN 0 ELSE value*probability/100 END),0)
 FROM visible GROUP BY bucket
$function$

functions.name: crm_relationship_timeline_filtered
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crm_relationship_timeline_filtered(p_org uuid, p_company uuid, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0, p_limit integer DEFAULT 30, p_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_from timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(event_key text, module text, record_type text, record_id uuid, title text, occurred_at timestamp with time zone, detail text, total_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 WITH valid AS(SELECT id FROM companies WHERE id=p_company AND organization_id=p_org AND deleted_at IS NULL AND public.can_access_module(p_org,'crm')),
 people AS(SELECT id FROM contacts WHERE organization_id=p_org AND company_id=p_company AND deleted_at IS NULL),
 opportunities AS(SELECT * FROM deals WHERE organization_id=p_org AND company_id=p_company AND deleted_at IS NULL AND public.crm_record_visible(organization_id,owner_id)),
 prospects AS(SELECT * FROM leads WHERE organization_id=p_org AND converted_contact_id IN(SELECT id FROM people) AND deleted_at IS NULL AND public.crm_record_visible(organization_id,owner_id)),
 events AS(
 SELECT 'activity:'||a.id AS event_key,'crm'::text AS module,
 CASE WHEN a.deal_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'deal' WHEN a.lead_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'lead' WHEN a.contact_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'contact' ELSE 'company' END AS record_type,
 coalesce(a.deal_id,a.lead_id,a.contact_id,a.company_id) AS record_id,a.subject AS title,coalesce(a.completed_at,a.created_at) AS occurred_at,
 a.activity_type||CASE WHEN a.due_at IS NOT NULL AND a.completed_at IS NULL THEN ' · scheduled follow-up' ELSE ' · logged activity' END AS detail
 FROM crm_activities a WHERE a.organization_id=p_org AND (a.company_id=p_company OR a.contact_id IN(SELECT id FROM people) OR a.deal_id IN(SELECT id FROM opportunities) OR a.lead_id IN(SELECT id FROM prospects))
 AND (a.deal_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM deals d WHERE d.id=a.deal_id AND d.organization_id=p_org AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND public.crm_record_visible(d.organization_id,d.owner_id)))
 AND (a.lead_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM leads l WHERE l.id=a.lead_id AND l.organization_id=p_org AND l.deleted_at IS NULL AND public.crm_record_visible(l.organization_id,l.owner_id)))
 UNION ALL SELECT 'lead:'||id,'crm','lead',id,btrim(first_name||' '||last_name),converted_at,'Lead converted' FROM prospects WHERE converted_at IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT 'deal-created:'||id,'crm','deal',id,name,created_at,'Opportunity created' FROM opportunities
 UNION ALL SELECT 'deal-closed:'||id,'crm','deal',id,name,closed_at,CASE WHEN stage='closed_won' THEN 'Deal won' ELSE 'Deal lost' END FROM opportunities WHERE stage IN ('closed_won','closed_lost') AND closed_at IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT 'stage:'||e.id,'crm','deal',d.id,d.name,e.created_at,'Stage changed: '||coalesce(e.from_stage::text,'new')||' → '||e.to_stage::text FROM deal_stage_events e JOIN opportunities d ON d.id=e.deal_id WHERE e.organization_id=p_org
 UNION ALL SELECT 'contact:'||id,'crm','contact',id,btrim(first_name||' '||last_name),created_at,'Contact added' FROM contacts WHERE organization_id=p_org AND company_id=p_company AND deleted_at IS NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT 'project:'||id,'projects','project',id,name,created_at,'Project created · current status: '||status::text FROM crm_visible_projects WHERE organization_id=p_org AND client_company_id=p_company AND deleted_at IS NULL AND public.can_access_module(p_org,'projects')
 UNION ALL SELECT 'milestone:'||m.id,'projects','project',p.id,m.name,coalesce(m.completed_at,m.created_at),CASE WHEN m.completed_at IS NULL THEN 'Milestone created' ELSE 'Milestone completed' END FROM milestones m JOIN crm_visible_projects p ON p.id=m.project_id AND p.organization_id=m.organization_id WHERE m.organization_id=p_org AND p.client_company_id=p_company AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND public.can_access_module(p_org,'projects')
 UNION ALL SELECT 'meeting:'||e.id,'projects','project',p.id,e.title,e.starts_at,'Scheduled meeting' FROM calendar_events e JOIN crm_visible_projects p ON p.id=e.project_id AND p.organization_id=e.organization_id WHERE e.organization_id=p_org AND p.client_company_id=p_company AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND public.can_access_module(p_org,'projects') AND public.can_access_module(p_org,'calendar')
 UNION ALL SELECT 'invoice:'||id,'finance','invoice',id,invoice_number,created_at,'Invoice created · '||currency||' '||total::text FROM invoices WHERE organization_id=p_org AND company_id=p_company AND deleted_at IS NULL AND public.can_access_module(p_org,'finance')
 UNION ALL SELECT 'payment:'||p.id,'finance','invoice',i.id,i.invoice_number,p.paid_at,'Payment recorded · '||i.currency||' '||p.amount::text FROM payments p JOIN invoices i ON i.id=p.invoice_id AND i.organization_id=p.organization_id WHERE p.organization_id=p_org AND i.company_id=p_company AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND public.can_access_module(p_org,'finance')
 UNION ALL SELECT 'ticket:'||id,'support','ticket',id,subject,created_at,'Support ticket opened' FROM support_tickets WHERE organization_id=p_org AND contact_id IN(SELECT id FROM people) AND deleted_at IS NULL AND public.can_access_module(p_org,'support')
 UNION ALL SELECT 'ticket-resolved:'||id,'support','ticket',id,subject,resolved_at,'Support ticket resolved' FROM support_tickets WHERE organization_id=p_org AND contact_id IN(SELECT id FROM people) AND deleted_at IS NULL AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND public.can_access_module(p_org,'support')
 ) SELECT e.*,count(*) OVER() FROM events e WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM valid) AND (p_type IS NULL OR split_part(e.event_key,':',1)=p_type) AND (p_from IS NULL OR e.occurred_at>=p_from) AND (p_to IS NULL OR e.occurred_at<p_to) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC,event_key DESC OFFSET greatest(0,least(p_offset,100000)) LIMIT greatest(1,least(p_limit,50))
